description: Elections Commission - Notice under Section 66 A(1) (a) Filling of a vacancy in the Office of  Member of the Manmunai Pattu Pradeshiya Sabha.
categorisation: This gazette notice specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government authority (Manmunai Pattu Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for a local government body, including the declaration of a newly elected member to fill a vacancy caused by death, which falls squarely under election-related matters.
